data_fields.name: backlogShare
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 / 40 of the remaining backlog per slice

best_idea: Stream world props by chunk window with a reference set per prop, drain load and unload backlogs in slices sized to a fixed share of what is left, and share one refcounted model blueprint across instances so an animated model advances once.
decision_why: The chunk-reference set and backlog-proportional slice fit zones as data, but Frankendom must first fix the late-load leak, duplicate in-flight loads, cached failures and idle timers, and must map props to zone content rather than to spawns.
acceptance: A unit test walks a 25 x 25 chunk window back and forth; every prop is released exactly once when its last chunk leaves; a prop removed mid-load is released, not shown; a failed chunk or model load is retried on the next window change; no timer runs while the pending queues are empty.
